title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Clear counter clutter and add everyday storage with this wall-mounted glass shelf—also a bathroom shelf or wall shelf—with an integrated towel bar (towel rack/towel holder) for towels at the sink. Designed for the Waverly Place collection, it coordinates easily with matching Waverly Place pieces and complements transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Store toiletries where you need them with a tempered, beveled-edge glass shelf
- Hang a hand towel within reach using the built-in towel bar (towel rail)
- Depend on solid brass hardware and brass construction for lasting wall-hanging support
- Save space with a wall mount / wall-mounted installation

Specs & Installation:
- Shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Glass thickness: 3/8 inch (0.38 in)
- Projection from wall: 5 inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4)
- Assembly required: no
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
